methods.steps: Open the HEIF in Preview; choose File > Export; pick PDF in the Format menu and click Save.
methods.limits: Preview opens HEIF files on macOS High Sierra and later.

methods.steps: Open the HEIF; choose File > Export As; end the name in .pdf and click Export; set the PDF options.
methods.limits: Needs GIMP 2.10.2 or later to load HEIF. Layers as pages and Fill transparent areas with background color are PDF export options.

methods.steps: Run cwebp portrait.jpeg -q 85 -o portrait.webp; add -lossless for the lossless mode.
methods.limits: No metadata is kept by default.

methods.steps: Open the JPEG; choose File > Export As to start the export; the WebP dialog offers Lossless, Image quality and Exif, XMP and color profile options.
methods.limits: Exif, XMP and color profile are separate options.
WebP writing needs ImageMagick's WebP delegate library.
The libmp3lame encoder needs a build configured with it.

methods.steps: Install the optional FFmpeg library and open the .opus file; choose File > Export Audio, pick MP3 in the Format menu, then choose the Bit Rate Mode.
methods.limits: Audacity does not read Opus natively; it tries FFmpeg when that library is installed.

methods.steps: Choose the AVI or enter a direct video URL and upload it; enter start and end times, pick a size and a frame rate, then make the GIF.
methods.limits: The video is uploaded; files up to 200 MB, 60 seconds at 5 frames a second and 30 seconds at 10; uploaded files are deleted after an hour.
ImageMagick writes BMP version 4 by default; BMP3 and BMP2 select older headers.

methods.steps: Run flac -d album-track.flac; decoding creates a WAV file by default.
methods.limits: The flac tool reads FLAC natively.

methods.steps: Open the FLAC; choose File > Export Audio; select WAV and the PCM encoding you need.
methods.limits: The Encoding menu defaults to Signed 16-bit PCM.

methods.steps: Run ffmpeg -i album-track.flac -c:a pcm_s24le album-track.wav for 24-bit PCM output.
methods.limits: Pick the PCM encoding that matches your source.

methods.steps: Open the JPG; choose File > Export As, name it portrait.gif and click Export.
methods.limits: The image is reduced to 256 colors or fewer; the dialog advises indexed mode first, and partial transparency cannot be kept.
A GIF palette holds up to 256 colors, which can change photograph colors.
Needs a stylesheet that produces valid XSL-FO; plain XML does not define a page layout.
The libmp3lame encoder needs a build configured with it.
